name: Outside micrometer, 1-2 in
description: 1-2 in outside micrometer with ratchet stop, for checking diameters and thicknesses to 0.0001 in.
license: self-made parametric generator (moonshot.library.generators, family micrometer), from Mitutoyo's published dimensions; not the maker's CAD
notes: ll-1007224's two Ø31.500 g6 spigots: mic1 reads 0-1 in, short of 31.5 mm. Model generated by moonshot.library.generators (family micrometer) from Mitutoyo's own 103-178 datasheet (shop.mitutoyo.eu) and the 103 series' dimension drawing on it (103-927-10_d2): the anvil a 2.5 mm out of the frame, b 10 mm beside it, a c 38 mm throat, the d 6.35 mm spindle, an 18 mm thimble, the head 14.5 + 3 + 47 + 17 mm from the barrel's face, 215 g. Its L reads 30.3 mm, the 0-1 in 103-177's figure, which leaves no room for a 1-2 in reading; the metric 25-50 mm twin (103-138, the same b, c and 215 g) has 55.3 = 30.3 + 25, so L is taken as 30.3 + 25.4 = 55.7 mm. The drawing gives no depth for the bow below the throat, so it is measured off Mitutoyo's own 103-178 photo on the same page (103-178_z, a straight side view), scaled by the 38 mm throat: 126 px under a 199.5 px throat, 24.0 mm (by the spindle's 6.35 mm instead, 23.5); the frame's green-grey (73, 94, 97) is that photo's too. The frame 8 mm thick, without its lightening holes, name plate or spindle lock, the sleeve 14 mm across, 22 mm of the 47 the thimble and the ratchet 10 mm across [proposed]. Shown opened to 1.5 in, lying on its side as mic1. Mitutoyo's pages link no CAD; its CAD needs an account.
